scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The correction is derived from the direct-sum geometry and independently cross-checked against the source's single-layer, symmetric-layer, matching-mode, and later band-edge formulas. The asymptotic density follows from an exact floor sum.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: Counts quantum-number branch labels rather than distinct numerical energies; does not address widths or crossings of absolutely continuous bands, gap counts, or random perturbations.

title: Correct flat-band lattice and asymptotic mode density in laterally coupled magnetic layers
